QUOTE: `include/mbedtls/mbedtls_config.h` has both `MBEDTLS_THREADING_C` (line 3787) and `MBEDTLS_THREADING_PTHREAD` (line 2196) commented out.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer names both macros as the gating options (THREADING_C guards the code, PTHREAD selects the backend) and says that enabling them is required for locking.
